description:
Move the validated profile identity and its lowercase-kebab predicate into the domain layer.

## Background

`ProfileId` (`crates/jit/src/profile/manifest.rs:23-49`) validates through `is_lowercase_kebab` (`manifest.rs:397`) in `TryFrom` and deserialization, and lives in `profile/`. `domain/types.rs:1183` names `crate::profile::ProfileId`, a dependency from the domain outward. `RegionId` (`manifest.rs:74`) uses the same predicate. `ProfileId` is referenced in 13 files under `crates/jit/src`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ProfileId` and the lowercase-kebab predicate are defined in `domain::identity`, and `ProfileId` is constructed only through validation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each reference imports `crate::domain::identity::ProfileId`, and the domain imports nothing from `profile` for it.
- [hard] REQ-03: `RegionId` validates through the domain predicate, and no second copy of the predicate exists.
title: ProfileId is defined in the domain layer
